# Owner decisions 2026-10-24 (c)

lsc2pAdmissionExcerpt.gateGP0: No RED installer build, packaged run or spec RED commit until Root records rulings on Q1, Q2 and Q8 (in the OWNER-RULING on PR #2332 or a later Root receipt). Q8 is an owner product decision: (a) accept and record; (b) accept and record plus the free-seat readmission scenario S5b (second campaign B, old seat-2 identity joins B, re-provision, new identity joins B into the free seat while the ghost stays); (c) register a GM participant-removal UI unit before LSC-2P RED (Step 2 budget above 8, owner approval); (d) fold a removal UI leaf into LSC-2P by a further registration correction (new fit measurement; conflicts with N2 and G-P6). Under (a) or (b) Root registers the removal control as a named product follow-up with an owner, due before the v2.2.0 human session, and the proof doc states the lock-out. Q2 must be ruled explicitly because the registered behavior says the unit retains the unchanged 30-second test timeout.

q8.question: S5 cannot reach "GM readmission" or "ghost removal" in the ordinary UI: the new identity is refused (tactical seats full) and no removal control exists. Accept recording this, or register a GM removal UI leaf (a new product unit and PR)?
q8.disposition: RECOMMENDED: accept and record. The packaged claim becomes: re-provision gives a new distinct playerId; the guest reclaims (mint succeeds); the host refuses the new identity while the ghost holds a seat; removal UI is absent; nothing more is claimed. A removal leaf would add at least one PR and break the 8-PR budget of Step 2, so it needs an owner answer. This admission amends S5 accordingly and adds mutant M8.
